record.field: The call site is in write / create (or another generic hook) of a class with _inherit = 'base': the override runs for every write / create of every model.

Callsite in write/create of an `_inherit = 'base'` class: the issue hits EVERY model. Fix = a tools.ormcache'd frozenset of the (small) list of relevant model names, `if self._name not in names: return super()...` first, and clear the cache (self.clear_caches()) when the config records change. Moving a search out of a loop is NOT the fix.
